reuse.why: Extends the existing shared pre-link guard in accounts/link.ts that every provider link function already calls, instead of adding per-provider checks.

duplication.why: The closed-account check is written once and reached by all six provider link paths.

placement.why: The validation sits in link.ts next to the existing 'already linked' rule, the module the tree uses for link preconditions.

scope.why: Focused; the rename of the guard forces six mechanical call-site edits that are not strictly needed but keep the name honest.

maintainability.why: One documented precondition function covering both link rules is easy to own and extend.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All provider link functions in accounts/app.ts go through link.assertBankAccountCanBeLinked.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountCanBeLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/link.ts, called by the GoCardless, SimpleFIN, Pluggy, Akahu, EnableBanking and Fintegra link paths.
